title: Construction of the Great Bath at Mohenjo-daro
description: Civic engineers in the citadel mound construct a 12-by-7 metre baked brick tank sealed with bitumen, representing one of the earliest public water structures in human history.

title: Proclamation of Ashoka's Moral Edicts
description: Following the Kalinga War, Ashoka commissions monolithic pillars and rock inscriptions promoting religious tolerance, non-violence, and social welfare throughout his realm.

title: Foundation of Nalanda University
description: Gupta monarchs patronize the establishment of a residential university that attracts thousands of scholars from Asia for monastic philosophy, linguistics, and mathematics.

title: Commencement of the Taj Mahal
description: Emperor Shah Jahan initiates construction of the white Makrana marble mausoleum for empress Mumtaz Mahal along the Yamuna riverfront.

title: Foundation of the Red Fort in Shahjahanabad
description: Shah Jahan lays the foundation of the massive red sandstone palace-fortress (Qila-i Mubarak) as the political anchor of his new capital.

title: The Salt Satyagraha Reaches Dandi
description: Gandhi completes the 24-day walk from Sabarmati to Dandi and breaks the British salt monopoly, sparking nationwide civil disobedience.

sources.title: The Collected Works of Mahatma Gandhi (Vol. 43)
sources.authorOrCitation: Publications Division, Ministry of Information & Broadcasting

title: Chandrayaan-3 Touches Down at Lunar South Pole
description: The Vikram lander, launched from Sriharikota, makes history as the first spacecraft to soft-land in the Moon's south polar region at 'Shiva Shakti' point.
